lines.intro: A fizzy hedgehog waddles out of the meadow, quills all a-twinkle!
lines.command: How can Fae calm the hedgehog?

soothe.great: Fae whispers a quiet tune. The hedgehog curls up peacefully.
soothe.good: Fae whispers softly. The hedgehog blinks beneath its hat.
soothe.miss: The hedgehog grumbles louder than Fae.

play.great: Maddie plays peekaboo behind a fern. The hedgehog uncurls!
play.good: Maddie wiggles a leaf. The hedgehog peeks out.
play.miss: Maddie pounces at a shadow. The hedgehog curls tight.

cast.great: Sue casts her ribbon through the meadow. The hedgehog follows it!
cast.good: Sue twirls her ribbon. The hedgehog watches.
cast.miss: Sue’s ribbon tangles in a daisy. The hedgehog blinks.

juggle.great: Jordan juggles pinecones. The hedgehog hoots in rhythm!
juggle.good: Jordan tosses a pinecone. The hedgehog sniffs it.
juggle.miss: Jordan drops a pinecone with a thunk. The hedgehog grumbles.

lines.snack: Fae offers a fizzy cracker crumb. The hedgehog nibbles carefully.
lines.burst: The hedgehog curls and sends a ring of fizzy quills through the meadow!

burstResult.great: Fae steps neatly through the ring!
burstResult.miss: Ouch! Fae gets a poke from a fizzy quill.

lines.soothed: The hedgehog gives a sleepy snuffle. The fizzy spell fades away!
lines.rest: Fae needs a quiet rest after those prickles.
lines.run: Fae backs away through the meadow. The hedgehog watches.
